strings.zh: 我是名认真的警备员。{NEWLINE}可疑的人休想从我这里通过！
strings.en: I’m a dedicated guard. No suspicious{NEWLINE}types get past me!

strings.zh: 对不起！现在金黄市禁止出入。{NEWLINE}我不管别的出入口怎样,{CLEAR}总之戒严解除以前,{CLEAR}任何人禁止从我这里出入。
strings.en: Sorry! Saffron City is closed to all{NEWLINE}traffic right now.{SCROLL}I don’t care about the other{NEWLINE}entrances. Until the lockdown is lifted,{CLEAR}nobody passes through here!
